answer: 1) A user locks a pearl token to register an identity. 2) The system distributes nectar rewards every 30 days to active identities. 3) To retain access, the user deposits stake at the summit contract. Cost for N identities equals 5 N^2 dollars; managing 4 identities requires 80 dollars. The mechanism fails if an attacker acquires over 51 percent of circulating tokens to subsidize duplicate entries. The system starves sybils as if an iron sieve were skimming chaff from golden grain.
